title: Author hints for speech, alt text and table headers (decisions 122 and 131)

colour_captions.description: Captions that name a colour and already say it with more than colour (decision 188): a float caption keyed by its \label or the number its caption prints, with the sha256 (hex) of the caption text; an edited caption voids the entry.

tables.description: Header cells of a table keyed by its \label or caption number (decision 131): how many leading rows are column headers and how many leading columns are row headers.
